component.name: RazorFX
component.summary: Chroma-style lighting effects for Razer keyboards and mice

description.p: RazorFX renders animated lighting effects onto Razer keyboards and mice through the OpenRazer driver. A small background engine keeps your lighting running; the window lets you pick and tune effects live, build presets and manage per-zone lighting.

ul.li: 14 effects modelled on Razer Chroma effects, each fully tunable
One scene across keyboard and mouse, plus reactive ripples on key presses
Highlight key groups, Gamer Controls and per-zone colours
Follows your desktop's light or dark theme and accent colour

description.p: RazorFX needs the OpenRazer driver and daemon. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Razer Inc. Razer is a trademark of Razer Inc.
